cards.text: Jehu, Israel's new king, has just struck down everyone left of Ahab's house in Samaria, just as the LORD said through Elijah (2 Kings 10:17). He even invited Jehonadab son of Rechab to ride along and see his zeal for the LORD (2 Kings 10:16). Now Jehu brings all the people together for a big announcement.

Then he says it: "Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot." From Mr. Zeal for the LORD himself, that's like the new manager announcing, "The last guy took a lot of days off? Oh, watch me take MORE."

cards.question: Jehu orders every prophet, servant and priest of Baal summoned, with nobody missing. What does he say he has planned for Baal?
And for any of Baal's prophets, servants or priests who don't show up, what does Jehu say will happen?
Jehu is truly planning to serve Baal.

cards.text: Jehu is acting deceptively so he can destroy the servants of Baal, and the man is COMMITTED. He orders a solemn assembly for Baal, and the word goes out through all of Israel.

cards.question: A few of Baal's servants decide to skip Jehu's assembly for Baal.

cards.text: Every last one of them shows up, and the temple of Baal is filled from end to end, packed tighter than a cookie box on Christmas Eve. Then Jehu turns to the keeper of the wardrobe with an order.

cards.question: Jehu tells the keeper of the wardrobe to bring out ___ for all the servants of Baal.

cards.text: Everybody's dressed for the occasion. Then Jehu walks in with Jehonadab son of Rechab, the man Jehu took along in his chariot (2 Kings 10:16), and he gives Baal's servants one more instruction.

cards.question: Jehu tells Baal's servants to look around and make sure nobody from one group is in the temple with them. Which group?

cards.text: Inside, they go in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Outside, Jehu has stationed men of his own.

cards.question: Jehu stations ___ men outside the temple of Baal.
Jehu warns his guards that whoever lets even one of the men escape will forfeit his own life for theirs.

cards.text: When the burnt offering is finished, the moment Jehu planned all this for finally comes. He tells his guards and officers to go in and kill them, and not to let ANYONE out.

cards.question: The guards and officers strike down Baal's servants and throw the bodies out. Where do they go next?

answers.text: Into the inner room of Baal's temple
Up to the king's palace in Samaria
Out to the city gate of Jezreel

cards.text: Then the guards and officers bring out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal. Out it comes, like a couch on moving day.

cards.question: Jehu's men bring out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and ___ it.

cards.text: They demolish the sacred pillar of Baal, tear down his temple and turn it into a latrine, which it still was when this was written. From temple to latrine is the BIGGEST demotion I've ever heard of, friend, and I went from the kitchen counter to the junk drawer.

cards.question: With Baal's servants dead and Baal's temple torn down, Baal worship still hangs on in Israel.

cards.text: Baal's gone from Israel. But there are also the golden calves at Bethel and Dan, the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat, Israel's first king after the kingdom split (1 Kings 12:20), caused Israel to commit.

cards.question: Jehu just wiped Baal out of Israel. What does he do about the golden calves at Bethel and Dan, the sins Jeroboam caused Israel to commit?

answers.text: He doesn't turn away from them
He tears them all down too

cards.text: Nevertheless, hold on, friend, because the LORD has something to say to Jehu. The LORD says Jehu has done well in carrying out what is right in His sight, and has done to the house of Ahab all that was in His heart.

cards.question: Because Jehu did well in the LORD's sight and did to Ahab's house all that was in the LORD's heart, the LORD makes Jehu a promise about Israel's throne. Who will sit on it?
Jehu is not careful to follow the instruction of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart.

cards.text: In those days, the LORD begins to do something to the land of Israel itself. Friend, lean in for this one.

cards.question: In the days of Jehu's reign, the LORD begins to ___ the size of Israel.

cards.text: Hazael king of Aram (2 Kings 8:28) defeats the Israelites throughout their territory, from the Jordan eastward through all the land of Gilead, and from Aroer by the Arnon Valley through Gilead to Bashan.

The rest of Jehu's acts, his accomplishments and all his might are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel, which I'm calling the Jehu highlight reel. Then Jehu rests with his fathers and is buried in Samaria.

cards.question: After Jehu is buried in Samaria, who reigns in his place?
Jehu reigns over Israel in Samaria for ___ years.
